name: Jefferson Parish, Louisiana (United States)
description: Light blue field charged at the centre with the parish emblem: a green ring reading JEFFERSON PARISH around a map of the parish and SINCE FEB. 11 1825.
history: Jefferson Parish is a parish in the New Orleans metropolitan area. Flags of the World records that the emblem with the shape of the parish was adopted in 1961, originally on a white field and by 2011 on a blue one; a new emblem and flag were unveiled in March 2021.

features.role: parish emblem in green, a map of the parish in a ring reading JEFFERSON PARISH SINCE FEB. 11 1825
